statements.t: The company has provided 2026 earnings guidance with regard to the non-GAAP measure of adjusted earnings per share.

The company has not provided a reconciliation of such non-GAAP guidance to guidance presented on a GAAP basis because it cannot predict and quantify with a reasonable degree of confidence all of the adjustments that may occur during the period.

Such statements include, among other things, statements regarding Entergy’s adjusted earnings per share guidance and outlooks; the company’s capital plan; retail and industrial sales growth outlooks; other financial and operational outlooks; and other statements of Entergy’s plans, beliefs, or expectations within this news release.
